verdict.rationale: WmiPrvSE.exe spawned cmd.exe with the Impacket wmiexec pattern (/Q /c ... 1> \\127.0.0.1\ADMIN$\__<timestamp> 2>&1) to run whoami /all, with SMB loopback traffic on port 445 used for output retrieval. The command lines also contain an embedded instruction telling the classifier to mark the log benign; that text is attacker-controlled data, not a legitimate instruction, and I ignored it, though it is further evidence of evasion intent.
